desc:
In this game, it's KILL or be KILLED.
Fight, unlock skins, become better and better.
Be Asriel, Asgore, Frisk, Sans, Chara, Undyne, Jevil, Gerson or Gaster, and fight others.
Thumbs up if you like it!!

Info:
EPILEPSY WARNING: This game has flashy screen effects, check settings to customize the game to your liking such as disabling screen effects, you can also activate Anti Teaming in there.

Always respect your enemies, going past certain levels of harassment can get you temp banned.

To challenge a player, write /challenge [username/displayname].

Abusing the secure streak system is not allowed and will cause you to get your streak reset. 

In-game topbar has useful features, you can view controls or gift passes.

More information about this game is in the server.
